decisiveFact: isAnthropicAuthEnabled() is `return false` (wave D step 1), so isClaudeAISubscriber() early-returns false, getOauthAccountInfo() returns undefined and getSubscriptionType()/getRateLimitTier() return null; hasProfileScope() is false for a second, independent reason — the only two OAuthTokens producers left in this build (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN and the inherited file descriptor) hardcode scopes ['user:inference'].
